summary: Full stack testing of LedgerSync. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passing (auth, dashboard, CRUD, checkout, listener, ERP, settings). Frontend: smoke-tested all 7 dashboard nav pages, login (no redirect-race), create checkout link flow, logout, public /pay/<nonce> page without auth, Google button on login, forgot-password page. No critical bugs found.

issues: Recharts emits width(-1)/height(-1) warnings when the chart container renders before layout settles — purely cosmetic console noise, chart still renders
Missing aria-describedby / DialogDescription — accessibility warning in console (not user-visible)

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to Radix DialogContent components to clear a11y warnings
(Optional) Backend PUT /api/subscriptions/{sid} currently requires full SubscriptionIn (customerId+productId); the frontend accommodates this, but a status-only PATCH would be cleaner
(Optional) /api/dashboard/stats returns totalCollected (not collectedUsdc as referenced in the review request wording) — frontend uses the actual field, so this is a doc mismatch only
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext race-fix (setUser((prev) => prev ? prev : false)) correctly prevents the login→/login bounce; verified end-to-end
Login/Register/Forgot-password all use httpOnly cookies with SameSite=None; Secure — observed in response headers
Forgot-password returns identical generic body for registered vs unregistered emails (verified via test); reset tokens are stored as sha256 hashes (verified in server.py)
/api/checkout/{nonce} is correctly public (no auth dependency); /confirm validates txHash regex (0x + 64 hex) before any RPC call — good defense in depth
server.py is 909 lines in a single file — above the 700-line threshold; recommend splitting into routers/ (auth, invoices, listener, erp)
run_erp_sync is clearly flagged as MOCKED per request
